battle.name: 蘇日國界戰爭
battle.brief: 一九三八年七八月，蘇聯與日本在遠東哈桑湖及周邊山脊地區交火，是蘇日國界戰爭在哈桑湖地區的重要事件。衝突源於兩國邊界標示與武裝巡邏爭端；德國陸軍砲兵自一八七〇年起便採用婆塞德後膛砲，作為提供曲射支援的重火力裝備。

kit.name: 婆塞德後膛砲
kit.history: 婆塞德後膛砲是德國陸軍野戰砲兵體系中的後膛火砲，負責提供曲射火力，支援步兵進攻與封鎖敵方陣地，並與其他砲兵單位協同作業。

countries: 交戰國與戰區：1938年5月11日至9月16日，蘇聯與蒙古人民共和國一方，由蘇聯遠東軍區所屬第五十七特別軍、蒙古第六與第八騎兵師等部隊，對抗日本陸軍關東軍及滿洲國軍。交戰陣容包括日本第二十三師團、第七十五獨立步兵聯隊、第四騎兵旅，以及第二戰車師團的部分戰車部隊；滿洲國方面則投入騎兵與邊防警察部隊。中華民國並未以國家身分直接參戰。戰區位於蒙古高原東緣、哈爾哈河沿線，蒙古人民共和國位於河流西北側，日本與滿洲國控制的內蒙古在東南側，鐵路終點雅克什距主要陣地約六十至七十公里。此役在中文史料常稱哈爾哈河戰役或諾門罕事件，在英文通常稱Battle of Khalkhin Gol或Battle of Nomonhan。雙方沒有宣戰，衝突先由邊境巡邏接觸引發，後來擴展為有限但密集的炮兵、戰車、騎兵與航空作戰。
countriesEn: Belligerents and theater: From 11 May to 16 September 1938, the Soviet Union and the Mongolian People's Republic fought against forces of the Japanese Kwantung Army and the Manchukuoan army. The Soviet-Mongolian side included units of the Soviet Far Eastern Military District's 57th Special Corps and the 6th and 8th Mongolian Cavalry Divisions. The Japanese-Manchukuoan field order included the Japanese 23rd Infantry Division, the 75th Independent Infantry Regiment, the 4th Cavalry Brigade, and elements of the 2nd Tank Division, together with Manchukuoan cavalry and border-guard troops. The Republic of China did not participate directly as a belligerent state. The battlefield lay on the eastern edge of the Mongolian Plateau along the Khalkhin Gol, with the Mongolian People's Republic on the northwestern side and Japanese- and Manchukuoan-held Inner Mongolia on the southeastern side. The railhead at Yakeshi stood roughly sixty to seventy kilometers from the principal positions. Chinese accounts commonly call the action the Battle of Khalkhin Gol or the Nomonhan Incident, while English-language histories usually use Battle of Khalkhin Gol or Battle of Nomonhan. Neither side declared war. The fighting began with contact between frontier patrols and grew into a limited but intensive conflict involving artillery, armor, cavalry, and aviation.
people: 關鍵人物與指揮鏈：蘇聯遠東軍區司令尼古拉·普爾卡耶夫掌握最高戰區權責，格列戈里·斯捷爾寧則擔任朱可夫的參謀長。朱可夫於七月底實際接管新編的第五十七特別軍，準備應對日軍可能的攻勢，並在8月19日將主要部隊編成第一軍集群。第五十七步兵師由米哈伊爾·扎哈羅夫上校指揮，第三十六摩托步兵師由伊萬·斯米爾諾夫上校指揮，第十一戰車旅由伊林上校指揮；蒙古第六與第八騎兵師則在蒙古軍總司令霍爾洛·吉·喬巴山及蘇聯參謀體系指導下作戰。日軍方面，關東軍司令梅津美治郎負責整體軍務，第六軍司令上田實協調第二十三師團及其增援，前線師團長小瓦田三郎實際部署第二十三師團第六十四、第七十一聯隊。朱可夫集中重炮、戰車和蒙古騎兵後，以五路正面攻擊配合兩側迂迴；上田與小瓦田則在日軍遭圍困時組織解圍與撤退。這條指揮鏈顯示，戰役初期是日軍前線主動試探，盛期則轉為蘇軍統一策劃的大規模攻勢。
peopleEn: Command figures and chain of command: General Nikolai Purkayev held overall authority over the Soviet Far Eastern Military District, while Grigory Shtern served as Zhukov's chief of staff. Zhukov took operational command of the newly formed 57th Special Corps in late July to meet the possibility of a Japanese offensive, and on 19 August he organized the principal formations into the 1st Army Group. Colonel Mikhail Zakharov commanded the 57th Rifle Division, Colonel Ivan Smirnov commanded the 36th Motor Rifle Division, and Colonel Ilyin led the 11th Tank Brigade. The 6th and 8th Mongolian Cavalry Divisions operated under the overall direction of Mongolian commander-in-chief Khorloogiin Choibalsan and the Soviet advisory command. On the Japanese side, Kwantung Army commander General Yoshijirō Umezu supervised the theater, Sixth Army commander General Ueda coordinated the 23rd Division and its reinforcements, and Lieutenant General Michitarō Komatsubara directed the 64th and 71st Infantry Regiments of the 23rd Division on the front. After concentrating heavy artillery, armor, and Mongolian cavalry, Zhukov coordinated frontal attacks with envelopment on both flanks. Ueda and Komatsubara in turn organized relief operations and withdrawals when the Japanese troops were encircled. This chain of command shows an initial Japanese attempt to test the frontier turning into a Soviet-planned mass offensive during the decisive phase.
kits: 裝備與後勤：蘇軍步兵使用莫辛－納甘M1891步槍及Maxim M1910／30式輕機槍，日軍使用三十八年式步槍、十一式及三十八式輕機槍。第十一戰車旅主要配備T-26輕型戰車與BT-7快速戰車，另有BA-10裝甲車；後續投入的第六十六戰車旅同樣以T-26、BT-7為核心。日軍第二十三師團及所屬戰車部隊使用九五式輕型戰車，戰車營亦配九七式重型戰車，後者在一九三八年才列裝，但已投入此役。蘇軍使用一九三六年式四五公厘反戰車砲、一九〇二年／三〇式七六・二公厘師屬砲，以及一九一〇／三〇式一五二公厘榴彈砲；日軍以三十八式、九〇式七五公厘野戰砲與九四式七五公厘山砲為主，七五式防空砲亦可執行對地及反戰車射擊。蘇聯航空隊使用I-16、I-15 fighters及SB-2、SB-3轟炸機，日軍使用三菱A5M與中島Ki-27戰鬥機。公路運輸以蘇聯ZIS-5、GAZ-AA卡車及日軍九四式、九五式卡車為主。彈藥供應包括七六・二與一五二公厘高爆榴彈、四五公厘穿甲彈、日軍三七與七五公厘穿甲彈，以及各型步槍彈、機槍彈和手榴彈。前線後方設有維修與回收車輛，故障戰車多由拖車或另一輛戰車拖回；最後數十公里的補給則依賴汽車、馬車及空投。
kitsEn: Equipment and logistics: Soviet infantry used the Mosin-Nagant M1891 rifle and Maxim M1910/30 light machine gun, while Japanese troops carried the Type 38 rifle, Type 11 light machine gun, and Type 38 light machine gun. The 11th Tank Brigade centered its strength on T-26 light tanks and BT-7 fast tanks, supported by BA-10 armored cars; the 66th Tank Brigade committed later in the battle also relied principally on T-26 and BT-7 vehicles. Japanese formations of the 23rd Division and attached tank units used Type 95 light tanks, while their tank battalions also included the Type 89 medium tank. Although the Type 89 entered service in 1938, it was already employed during this conflict. Soviet artillery included the 1936-model 45 mm anti-tank gun, the 1902/30-model 76.2 mm divisional gun, and the 1910/30-model 152 mm howitzer. Japanese artillery centered on the Type 38, Type 90, and Type 94 75 mm guns, with Type 75 75 mm anti-aircraft guns also available for ground and anti-tank tasks. Soviet aviation comprised I-16 and I-15 fighters and SB-2 and SB-3 bombers; Japanese units operated Mitsubishi A5M and Nakajima Ki-27 fighters. Road transport depended on Soviet ZIS-5 and GAZ-AA trucks and Japanese Type 94 and Type 95 trucks. Ammunition supplies included 76.2 mm and 152 mm high-explosive shells, 45 mm anti-tank rounds, Japanese 37 mm and 75 mm armor-piercing ammunition, and rifle, machine-gun, and grenade ammunition. Maintenance and recovery units operated behind the front, and disabled tanks were usually towed back by another tank or a recovery vehicle. The final tens of kilometers of the supply route were covered by motor vehicles, horse-drawn carts, and air drops.
tactics: 戰術經過：五月十一日，雙方巡邏隊在哈爾哈河東岸MTS土丘附近接觸後爆發近距離射擊，日方七十五人巡邏幾乎全滅，蘇蒙巡邏隊亦有損失，但雙方對開火責任的敘述從未一致。五月二十日及五月二十八日至六月二日，日軍以步兵、少量戰車與砲兵嘗試渡過哈爾哈河，卻屢次進入蘇聯預先構築的火力區；步兵與戰車分離推進，使前進縱隊受到縱深射擊切斷。七月十一日至十五日，日軍投入約三十輛戰車及大批步兵發動第二次大規模攻勢，蘇軍仍採縱深防守，以四五公厘砲消滅落單戰車，再用步兵反衝鋒封住突破口；蒙古第六騎兵師從側翼切斷撤退道路，日軍因此留下大量裝備與俘虜。八月二十日，朱可夫發動總攻：第五十七步兵師沿鐵路攻擊日軍第七十一聯隊，第三十六摩托步兵師在第十一戰車旅配合下攻擊北面的第六十四聯隊，蒙古第六、第八騎兵師封閉北翼，炮兵先以密集高爆彈削弱陣地，再由步兵清障、戰車突入。八月二十三日至三十一日，第六十四聯隊在拜塔格一帶被包圍，第七十一聯隊的鐵路陣地失守；日軍第二十五至二十七日派解圍部隊反擊，卻撞上蒙古騎兵與蘇聯戰車阻擋線。八月三十一日，小瓦田率殘部突圍，丟下重裝備。九月七日，日軍再以第二戰車師團部分兵力、第四騎兵旅及航空兵救援，九月八日發動Yamato騎兵衝鋒，但被裝甲車、戰車與機槍火力截住；第九日以後蘇軍第六十六戰車旅投入正面衝擊，至九月十五日瓦解日軍最後一次大規模突擊。
tacticsEn: Course of the tactics: On 11 May, opposing patrols made contact near the MTS hill east of the Khalkhin Gol and exchanged close-range fire. A Japanese patrol of seventy-five men was almost entirely wiped out, and the Soviet-Mongolian patrol also suffered losses, although the two sides never agreed on responsibility for opening fire. On 20 May and again from 28 May to 2 June, Japanese infantry, a small number of tanks, and artillery attempted crossings of the river. Their attacks repeatedly entered prepared Soviet fire zones, and the separation of infantry from armor allowed the attacking columns to be cut apart by fire at depth. From 11 to 15 July, the Japanese committed approximately thirty tanks and a large infantry force in another major attack. The Soviet defense remained in depth: 45 mm guns engaged tanks that had advanced alone, infantry counterattacks closed penetrations, and the 6th Mongolian Cavalry Division cut routes of withdrawal. The Japanese consequently abandoned substantial equipment and many prisoners. On 20 August, Zhukov launched his general offensive. The 57th Rifle Division struck the Japanese 71st Regiment along the railway, while the 36th Motor Rifle Division and 11th Tank Brigade attacked the 64th Regiment farther north. The 6th and 8th Mongolian Cavalry Divisions closed the northern escape route. Artillery first disrupted the positions with high-explosive shells, after which infantry cleared obstacles and armor drove into the captured ground. From 23 to 31 August, the 64th Regiment was surrounded near Baitag and the railway positions of the 71st Regiment collapsed. Japanese relief forces sent on 25 to 27 August struck the cavalry and armored blocking line instead of breaking through. On 31 August, Komatsubara escaped with the remnants of his command and abandoned heavy equipment. On 7 September, Japan committed elements of the 2nd Tank Division, the 4th Cavalry Brigade, and aviation in another relief effort. The Yamato cavalry attack of 8 September was halted by armored cars, tanks, and machine-gun fire. After the 66th Tank Brigade entered the frontal battle, Soviet forces broke up the last major Japanese assault by 15 September.
data: 日期、兵力與補給數據：主要節點依次為5月11日首次巡邏衝突、5月20日及5月28日至6月2日日軍早期攻勢、7月11日至15日第二次主要會戰、8月4日至6日前沿偵察與炮擊、8月20日至31日蘇軍攻勢及日軍突圍、9月7日至15日日軍最後救援，以及9月16日停火。八月決戰前，蘇蒙軍常見估計約五萬餘人，配有數百門火砲、數百輛裝甲車輛、數百輛坦克與約五百架飛機；日滿一方約三萬餘至四萬人，坦克逾百、飛機數百。蘇軍第十一戰車旅約有百輛輕型戰車，第六十六戰車旅後續加入；日方第二戰車師團只以北部的部分營、連投入。哈爾哈河前線長約五十至七十公里，河流多處可涉渡，但兩側高地、丘線與有限道路使裝甲車輛受到地形約束。蘇方物資由博爾扎亞鐵路樞紐轉運，經格列米亞切沃前進集結點再送往前線；日方則由雅克什鐵路站經公路輸送。火炮高爆彈、戰車燃料與飼料均需長距離後送，軍馬和空投因此成為末端運輸的重要手段。傷亡方面，蘇聯與蒙古軍的總減員約一萬上下，日滿軍總減員達數萬，戰俘超過兩萬；由於陣亡登記、重傷分類、病員統計及俘虜審查方式不同，各方數字無法直接互證，因此不列單一精確死亡總數。停火於9月16日13時10分生效。
dataEn: Dates, strengths, and supply: The principal landmarks were the first patrol clash on 11 May, Japanese attempts on 20 May and from 28 May to 2 June, the second major engagement from 11 to 15 July, reconnaissance and artillery fire along the front from 4 to 6 August, the Soviet offensive and Japanese breakout from 20 to 31 August, the final Japanese relief efforts from 7 to 15 September, and the ceasefire on 16 September. Before the decisive fighting in August, Soviet-Mongolian strength is commonly estimated at more than fifty thousand men, with hundreds of guns, armored vehicles, and tanks, and approximately five hundred aircraft. The Japanese-Manchukuoan side numbered roughly thirty to forty thousand men, more than one hundred tanks, and several hundred aircraft. The Soviet 11th Tank Brigade possessed about one hundred light tanks, with the 66th Tank Brigade joining later; Japan committed only parts of battalions and companies from the northern portion of the 2nd Tank Division. The Khalkhin Gol front extended about fifty to seventy kilometers. Although there were several fords, the hills, ridgelines, and limited roads restricted armored maneuver. Soviet supplies moved from the Borzya rail hub through the Gremyachevo forward base, while Japan sent matériel by road from the Yakeshi railhead. High-explosive artillery ammunition, tank fuel, and animal fodder all required long-distance movement, making horse transport and air drops important at the end of the route. In terms of losses, Soviet and Mongolian total casualties were around ten thousand, whereas Japanese-Manchukuoan losses reached several tens of thousands and included more than twenty thousand prisoners. Different methods of recording deaths, severe wounds, illness, and prisoners prevent direct comparison of all published totals, so no single exact death figure is used here. The ceasefire took effect at 13:10 on 16 September.
cause: 戰爭原因：蘇日邊界問題源於1921年蘇日基本條約及其後續修約，兩國從未完整劃定蒙古東部與滿洲國接壤地區的陸界，而日本長期不承認蒙古人民共和國的獨立地位，將其視為中國勢力範圍的一部分，滿洲國則主張較廣的邊界。蘇聯在蒙古部署第五十七特別軍、提供訓練與裝備，使蒙軍第六、第八騎兵師能配合蘇軍作戰；這使日本關東軍把哈爾哈河一帶視為測試蘇軍戰鬥力及保護南滿鐵路北翼的試探地帶。直接肇因是5月11日兩支巡邏隊在MTS土丘附近相遇後互相射擊，但造成全面衝突的是雙方指揮體系的升級：日本前線軍官希望藉有限攻勢迫使蘇聯退讓，蘇聯邊防與蒙古方面則把日軍集結視為進攻準備；7月日軍攻勢受挫後，關東軍繼續增兵，蘇軍也由守勢轉為集中兵力主動打擊。8月蘇軍察覺日軍戰車、步兵與航空部隊正集中，遂決定先以炮兵、戰車和步兵攻勢摧毀其集結態勢，戰爭因而由邊界摩擦變成雙方都以常規軍主力決戰的戰役。
causeEn: Causes of the war: The underlying Soviet-Japanese border problem originated in the 1921 Soviet-Japanese Basic Convention and its later amendments. The two states never fully delimited the land boundary between eastern Mongolia and Manchukuo, while Japan continued not to recognize the Mongolian People's Republic as independent and treated it as part of the Chinese sphere. Manchukuo claimed a wider frontier. The Soviet Union maintained the 57th Special Corps in Mongolia and provided training and equipment, enabling the 6th and 8th Mongolian Cavalry Divisions to operate alongside Soviet forces. Japan and the Kwantung Army consequently treated the Khalkhin Gol area as a place both to test Soviet combat power and to protect the northern flank of the South Manchurian Railway. The immediate occasion was the exchange of fire between two patrols near the MTS hill on 11 May, but escalation came from the decisions of both command systems. Japanese front-line officers sought to compel Soviet withdrawal through a limited offensive, while the Soviet and Mongolian authorities interpreted Japanese concentration as preparation for attack. After the Japanese July offensive failed, the Kwantung Army continued reinforcing the front, and the Soviet command changed from defense to a concentrated offensive. When Soviet intelligence detected Japanese tank, infantry, and aviation concentrations in August, Moscow decided to destroy the enemy buildup with an artillery, tank, and infantry attack. The border incident thus developed into a conventional major battle between the principal field forces of both sides.
impact: 軍事與戰略影響：日軍第二十三師團第六十四、第七十一聯隊及第七十五獨立步兵聯隊均遭重創，野戰部隊不得不重整；日軍投入的九五式戰車及大量裝備被留在前線，蘇軍則以第五十七步兵師、第三十六摩托步兵師、第十一與第六十六戰車旅的協同，確立遠東地區大規模機動作戰的經驗。蒙古第六、第八騎兵師完成對日軍縱隊的側翼切割，顯示蘇蒙聯合指揮在此次戰役中能形成實際戰術互補。朱可夫因此獲得遠東軍區的指揮權，戰後升任元帥；日本關東軍則撤換部分高級指揮官，並重新評估在北方與蘇聯正面對抗的代價。戰俘處理、返國運輸及後方醫療占用了日軍大量資源，數萬名日滿軍減員亦削弱關東軍在1938年中國戰場可持續投入的兵力。日本此後把主要擴張方向轉向華南、南進與太平洋方向，並在1941年蘇日中立條約中承認蒙古的獨立地位，停止以蒙古領土對蘇聯提出要求。蘇聯則鞏固蒙古國的國防與政治影響，並在遠東維持較高警戒。戰役成為戰後日本與蘇聯維持邊界現狀的重要軍事前提。
impactEn: Military and strategic effects: The Japanese 64th and 71st Infantry Regiments of the 23rd Division and the 75th Independent Infantry Regiment were all badly damaged, and surviving field units had to be reorganized. Japanese Type 95 tanks and much other equipment were abandoned on the battlefield. Soviet cooperation among the 57th Rifle Division, 36th Motor Rifle Division, 11th and 66th Tank Brigades, and the Mongolian cavalry produced practical experience in large-scale mobile operations in the Far East. The 6th and 8th Mongolian Cavalry Divisions cut Japanese columns on the flanks and demonstrated the tactical value of combined Soviet-Mongolian command during the operation. Zhukov gained authority over the Far Eastern forces and was promoted to marshal after the campaign. The Kwantung Army relieved several senior commanders and reassessed the cost of confronting the Soviet Union directly on its northern frontier. Prisoner handling, repatriation transport, and rear-area medical support consumed substantial Japanese resources, while losses of tens of thousands reduced the forces available to the Kwantung Army in the Chinese fighting of 1938. Japan subsequently concentrated its main expansion on southern China, southward expansion, and the Pacific, and in the 1941 Soviet-Japanese Neutrality Pact recognized Mongolia's independence and abandoned Japanese territorial demands directed at Mongolia. The Soviet Union consolidated the defense and political position of the Mongolian People's Republic and maintained a higher level of readiness in the Far East. The battle consequently became an important military premise for preserving the later border arrangement between Japan and the Soviet Union.
result: 直接結果：9月16日13時10分停火生效後，雙方停止炮火並大致退回合戰前線；日軍放棄此次攻勢所取得的哈爾哈河東岸大部分陣地，蘇蒙軍控制主要陣地與道路，日軍第二十三師團則撤回後方整編。停火不是正式和平條約，卻結束了戰區內的大規模戰鬥。兩國隨後交換俘虜並安排傷病俘返國，爭議地區由混合軍事委員會逐步處理；1939年至1941年的勘界工作最終把停火線轉化為較明確的蒙蘇邊界。蘇聯取得明確的戰術與戰役勝利，日軍則未能迫使蘇蒙軍撤退，也沒有取得諾門罕地區的軍事控制權；蘇聯雖以軍事勝利改變了邊界現狀，仍選擇以停火交換俘虜與外交談判，而非繼續向滿洲國境內擴張。1941年的蘇日中立條約及日方對蒙古獨立的承認，進一步確認了這項結果。總結戰局，蘇聯以炮兵、戰車、摩托步兵和蒙古騎兵的協同取得決定性優勢，日本則在付出重大代價後停止北進；此役從首次巡邏衝突發展至停火，雙方最終都沒有把這場未宣戰的邊界戰爭擴展成一場公開的全面國家戰爭。
resultEn: Direct outcome: When the ceasefire took effect at 13:10 on 16 September, both sides stopped firing and withdrew approximately to their prewar lines. The Japanese abandoned most of the ground east of the Khalkhin Gol gained during their offensive, while the Soviet-Mongolian forces retained the principal positions and roads. The 23rd Division withdrew to the rear for reorganization. The ceasefire was not a formal peace treaty, but it ended large-scale combat in the theater. The two states subsequently exchanged prisoners, arranged the return of the sick and wounded, and referred the disputed area to a joint commission. Survey work conducted from 1939 to 1941 gradually transformed the ceasefire line into a more clearly defined Mongolian-Soviet frontier. The Soviet Union achieved a clear tactical and operational victory, while Japan neither forced the Soviet-Mongolian forces back nor gained military control of the Nomonhan area. Although the Soviet Union changed the frontier situation through military success, it accepted a settlement involving prisoner exchange and negotiations rather than continuing the offensive into Manchukuo. The 1941 Soviet-Japanese Neutrality Pact and Japan's recognition of Mongolian independence subsequently reinforced that outcome. In strategic terms, Soviet coordination of artillery, armor, motorized infantry, and Mongolian cavalry produced a decisive advantage, while Japan halted its northern offensive at a very high cost. From the first patrol clash to the final ceasefire, neither government expanded this undeclared border conflict into a publicly declared total war.
